Interface BeanDependencyGroup

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable, BeanDependencyResolver
public sealed interface BeanDependencyGroup extends BeanDependencyResolver, AutoCloseable
An explicitly owned group of dependencies. Close the group to destroy its owned beans, in reverse creation order. Shared beans stay in their scopes. Closing is idempotent and attempts every dependent destruction. Use BeanContext.createDependencyGroup() for independent ownership or BeanDependencyResolver.createGroup() to attach the group to a managed consumer.

A group follows the lookup rules of BeanDependencyResolver: a group created before context shutdown remains usable by the ShutdownEvent listeners and destruction callbacks that run on the thread performing the shutdown. What such a lookup creates is destroyed before the shutdown completes, even when the group is independent and never closed; what the group held before shutdown remains the caller's to release.

Since:
5.3.0
